sideEffects: create mission-only checkpoint commits on dedicated branches when publish mode receives exclusively mission-owned changes
push checkpoint branches and one annotated continuation tag without force
fetch and adopt exact checkpoint heads in resume mode only after identity and cleanliness proof
keep prompts, reasoning, loaded context, observations and scratch outside Git and purge them at the parent-skill terminal
stopConditions: the publish or resume request does not explicitly authorize the required Git mutations
a checkout identity, route, branch, upstream or head is ambiguous
dirty or staged files include work outside the declared mission boundary
a push would overwrite history, target a protected delivery branch directly or require force
the continuation manifest contains source bodies, prompts, reasoning, credentials, absolute paths or session-only references
a resume target is dirty, the tag is missing or invalid, or any declared repository head cannot be reproduced
